portableEncryptedBackup.evidence: Encrypted backup and restore are implemented with synthetic regressions. Signed-device and cross-team portability, complete native file-dialog acceptance, maximum-history behavior and independent backup security approval remain unverified.

translations.evidence: Draft resources exist for all 12 localizations. Native-speaker review and complete localized/RTL visual and task acceptance remain incomplete.

hardwareValidation.evidence: Version 0.1.0 build 6 has completed Apple processing and is Testing in Miledge Internal for Mac and iOS/iPadOS. It includes international and structured input assistance and optional name components. Both Release archives and distribution uploads passed; see docs/testflight-build6-2026-10-17.md, docs/international-input-2026-10-17.md and docs/structured-input-2026-10-17.md. Signed physical-device authentication, upgrade retention, iCloud delivery and conflict recovery remain unverified. Internal distribution is not hardware acceptance.

accessibility.evidence: 2026-10-13: visual accessibility adaptations and native synthetic task tests cover Mac light/dark and grayscale, iPhone/iPad larger text, contrast and Reduce Motion settings. See docs/accessibility-2026-10-13.md for exact artifacts, measured contrast and remaining audit findings. Physical-device assistive technology, complete keyboard/focus, all locales and remaining workflows are unverified; the overall release gate remains blocked.

conflictRecovery.evidence: Immutable revisions and explicit whole-version conflict resolution are implemented. Signed cross-device conflicts, cloud attachment delivery and complete recovery behavior remain unverified or incomplete.
